translation: One text says: Its bowel is in the Qijie. The upper jiao is at the upper opening of the stomach, governed at Danzhong (CV17); the middle jiao is at the stomach duct, governed beside the navel; the lower jiao is below the navel at the upper opening of the bladder, governed at the navel. The Classic says: The primordial qi is the separate envoy of the Sanjiao.
